messages:
Maya (Support): Eli opened a ticket — after upgrading the Python SDK to 1.12 their prod service now throws a TypeError: got unexpected keyword 'timeout_ms'. Can SDK folks confirm if there was a breaking rename?
Alex (SDK): Yep — in 1.12 we renamed timeout_ms -> request_timeout to align with the REST API. We intended to add an alias but missed it in the release. My bad. :facepalm:
Eli (Customer): This hit prod traffic. Trace snip: ```File \"/srv/app/worker.py\", line 210, in handle
response = client.generate(prompt, timeout_ms=5000)
TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'timeout_ms'```
Pedro (Engineering): Oof. If they can't roll back (dependency graph) we should ship a 1.12.1 with a compatibility alias that accepts timeout_ms and maps it to request_timeout. Also double-check any default behavior changes that could affect latency/retries.
Jen (SRE): FWIW we also saw a small spike in 5xx surface errors after 1.12 rolled out in Canary. Might be related — Alex, did any retry defaults change?
Alex (SDK): Yes, we changed default retries from 2 -> 0 for non-idempotent paths. That was intentional but we didn't document it prominently. Could expose more transient HTTP errors to callers.
Maya (Support): Proposed immediate customer guidance: 1) pin to redwood-sdk==1.11.* until we ship a hotfix, 2) if they can, switch to request_timeout kwarg, 3) as a temporary mitigation catch TypeError and call client.generate with transformed kwargs. Example snippet: ```
# workaround
try:
    client.generate(prompt, timeout_ms=5000)
except TypeError:
    client.generate(prompt, request_timeout=5000)
```
Eli (Customer): Pinning to 1.11.3 fixed the crash for us. We still want the new features but need stability. Thanks for the quick answer.
Alex (SDK): I'll cut 1.12.1 with the alias + restore default retry to 2 for the next patch, and add a deprecation warning in the logs so users get notified on upgrade.
Pedro (Engineering): Deploy pipeline queued, adding a small test that asserts both timeout_ms and request_timeout are accepted.
deploy-bot: Deployment job started for redwood-python-sdk@1.12.1-hotfix (build 2789) — 1976543250
Alex (SDK): ETA ~45m. I'll update the support reply and put a concise migration note in the README with pin recommendation.
Maya (Support): Sending customer the pin + workaround now, will follow up when patch is live. :thumbsup:
Eli (Customer): Appreciated. We'll monitor and report latency if anything else pops up.
